title: FionaContracts
description: Fiona contracts v1. Generated by packages/contracts/tools/gen.mjs from packages/contracts/schemas/*.yaml. Do not edit.

Action.description: A button on a card. `route` must exist in the Window's route registry.

ActionType.description: Proposal types, plus decision_memo (memos are advice, never Proposals).

Actor.description: Who did something. An agent is named by AgentName, a user by UserId, the system by a short label.

AgentName.description: The six members of the council.

AutonomyLevel.description: advise: recommend only. prepare: draft a Proposal; the owner approves. act_within_mandate: executes after Guardian clearance, inside the limits.

confirmed_via.description: Only phone counts as out-of-band confirmation for G-03.

amount_minor.description: Money in is positive, money out is negative.

supersedes.description: Set when this re-submission replaces an earlier proposal (e.g. after a block's facts changed).

agent.description: The proposing agent. Any council member may appear here so an out-of-mandate attempt is recorded and blocked by the Guardian (G-13, e.g. the CFO Strategist submitting a payment) rather than silently rejected at intake with no verdict or audit entry.

amount.description: The money involved, or null for types that move none (send_document, reconciliation_match).

reasoning.description: Written from tool results; figures are cited, never typed by the model (R10).

created_by.description: The actor who originated the work (e.g. the user who uploaded the bill). G-04 compares it with the approver.

Check.description: One rule's result. `outcome` is what this rule contributes (a rule can map to different outcomes, e.g. G-13 block or escalate); a pass contributes approve.

detail.description: Plain-language reason. Starts with CHECK_ERROR: when the rule could not run.

CheckName.description: The four check families. Several checks may share a name (one entry per rule that ran).

Condition.description: Machine-checkable, so the wallet re-checks it at execution and refuses if it fails. Conflicting conditions make the outcome escalate.

CustomerReceiptEvent.description: Created by reconciliation (D4) when a credit is matched to invoices; never by the generator.

Date.description: A calendar date (YYYY-MM-DD), the business date in the tenant's time zone.

Decision.description: The recorded owner decision. Owner approval releases escalate only, never block (rulebook/guardian.yaml).

DecisionRequest.description: Body of POST /v1/proposals/{id}/decision. Send an Idempotency-Key header; a retry reuses it (CG-7).

assertion.description: WebAuthn assertion for passkey step-up (CG-8); stored in the audit record.

DocumentLine.description: A line on a supplier bill or customer invoice.

code.description: Stable machine code, e.g. not_implemented, validation_error, invalid_tenant.

message.description: A human sentence. Never a stack trace.

ErrorEnvelope.description: The body of every error response (CG-10).

EventSource.description: Where the event came from; `key` is the natural key used for idempotent imports.

Evidence.description: A pointer to where a claim comes from (R10, G-09). The Window opens it in the provenance popover.

Figure.description: A number with its provenance. status ok requires money or value. Any other status carries no value, and insufficient_data lists what is missing ("insufficient data, need X" instead of guessing).

FigureInput.description: One input to a Figure. Exactly one of money or value is set; money means unit "minor".

ref.description: An evidence ID, or a metric_id when origin is figure.

type.description: Module-specific kind, e.g. cash_below_buffer, dead_stock, duplicate_bill.

money_at_stake.description: What is at stake, used to rank the briefing. null when the finding has no money attached (it then ranks after those with money).

dedupe_key.description: Stable key so a re-run doesn't duplicate the same finding.

account.description: Account code from the chart of accounts.

version.description: Monotonic per (tenant, agent); a change writes a new row.

autonomy.description: Action type to autonomy level. An absent type is not permitted (G-13 blocks it).

allowed_action_types.description: Derived from the autonomy keys; kept for the Blueprint's mandates table.

Meta.description: How an agent output or verdict was produced (CG-13). A replayed answer is always labelled in the Window (R13).

Mode.description: Whether a response was produced from fixtures (mock) or real data (live).

Money.description: An amount in integer minor units (PKR 1 = 100 minor) plus its ISO 4217 code. Never a float (R3).

minor.description: Integer minor units. Negative only where the field says so.

Origin.description: Where a number or assumption comes from.

PartyId.description: A supplier (sup_), customer (cus_) or other party such as a landlord, utility, lender or tax authority (pty_).

channel.description: wallet = the simulated agent wallet; bank_file = a payment order file for the bank.

category.description: Mandate payment category, e.g. inventory_supplier, utilities, rent, logistics.

wallet_ref.description: Set when the simulated wallet executed it; null for historical payments.

TenantPolicies.description: The owner's tenant-level policies. cash_buffer_minor is read by the forecast, the briefing, Launch Lab and G-08.

Threshold.description: A rule threshold applied to a Figure, and whether it passed.

Timestamp.description: ISO 8601 instant in UTC with a trailing Z, e.g. 2026-10-22T09:15:00Z (R4).

Verdict.description: Immutable once written; a re-run creates a new verdict linked through previous_verdict_id. verdict_hash = "sha256:" + hex(SHA-256(canonical JSON (RFC 8785) of this object without verdict_hash)). The wallet refuses any payment without a verdict whose outcome is approve, or approve_with_conditions with every condition met.
